authorship: Written by the assistant for this project, not taken from the dataset, the training split or the test split, and not reviewed by a clinician. Expected labels follow the dataset's conventions as understood from the guidelines in the prompt. A qualitative sanity check, not a benchmark.

sentences: A 72-year-old man presents with three days of productive cough, fever of 38.9 C and shortness of breath.
He has a history of type 2 diabetes treated with metformin and a 40 pack-year smoking history.
On examination his oxygen saturation is 91% on room air and he has crackles over the right lower lobe.
A chest X-ray shows a right lower lobe consolidation.
His serum creatinine is 1.1 mg/dL and he takes no anticoagulants.
He lives alone and was discharged from a hospital stay for a hip fracture two weeks ago.

criteria.text: Oxygen saturation below 90% on room air.
criteria.label: not included

criteria.text: Hospital admission within the previous 30 days.
criteria.label: excluded

criteria.text: Severe renal impairment (serum creatinine above 3 mg/dL).
criteria.label: not excluded

sentences: A 34-year-old woman reports recurrent throbbing headaches for the past six months, usually on the left side.
Each episode lasts about 12 hours and is accompanied by nausea and sensitivity to light.
She has four to five episodes per month and takes sumatriptan with partial relief.
She has never had an aura.
Her blood pressure is 118/74 mmHg and a neurological examination is normal.
She is currently using an oral contraceptive pill.

criteria.text: At least 3 migraine attacks per month.
criteria.label: included

criteria.text: Failure of at least two preventive treatments.
criteria.label: not enough information

sentences: A 58-year-old woman is diagnosed with invasive ductal carcinoma of the left breast, 2.4 cm in diameter.
Biopsy shows estrogen receptor positive, progesterone receptor positive and HER2 negative disease.
Staging CT shows no distant metastases and sentinel lymph node biopsy is negative.
She has no history of heart failure, and her left ventricular ejection fraction is 62%.
She has received no prior chemotherapy.
